notes.summary: Coordinate geometry questions are few (0–1) but quick: distance, section formula, slope and area of a triangle.

concepts.title: Distance and section
concepts.body: Distance between (x<sub>1</sub>, y<sub>1</sub>) and (x<sub>2</sub>, y<sub>2</sub>) = √((x<sub>2</sub> − x<sub>1</sub>)<sup>2</sup> + (y<sub>2</sub> − y<sub>1</sub>)<sup>2</sup>). Point dividing in m : n internally = ((mx<sub>2</sub> + nx<sub>1</sub>)/(m + n), (my<sub>2</sub> + ny<sub>1</sub>)/(m + n)). Midpoint uses m = n.

concepts.title: Lines
concepts.body: Slope of ax + by + c = 0 is −a/b. Intercepts: x-intercept = −c/a, y-intercept = −c/b. Parallel lines have equal slopes; perpendicular lines have slopes multiplying to −1.

concepts.title: Area of a triangle
concepts.body: Area = ½ |x<sub>1</sub>(y<sub>2</sub> − y<sub>3</sub>) + x<sub>2</sub>(y<sub>3</sub> − y<sub>1</sub>) + x<sub>3</sub>(y<sub>1</sub> − y<sub>2</sub>)|. If the area is 0, the points are collinear.

varieties.name: Distance, midpoint, section
varieties.how: Plug into the formula; for m : n, multiply m with the second point.

varieties.name: Slope and lines
varieties.how: Rewrite as y = mx + c, or use −a/b.

varieties.name: Area of a triangle
varieties.how: Use the determinant formula, or ½ × base × height for intercept triangles.

example.q: Area of the triangle formed by x + y = 4 and the axes?

tips: A line x/a + y/b = 1 makes a triangle of area ½|ab| with the axes.
Sketch the points quickly to avoid sign errors.
traps: Slope of ax + by + c = 0 is −a/b, not a/b.
In the section formula, m goes with the SECOND point.

questions.q: What is the distance between the points (3, 4) and (−3, −4)?
What is the midpoint of the line segment joining (2, −3) and (6, 7)?
What is the slope of the line 3x − 4y + 7 = 0?
Find the point that divides the line segment joining (1, 2) and (7, 8) internally in the ratio 1 : 2.
Find the area of the triangle with vertices A(1, 2), B(4, 6) and C(7, 1).
What is the area of the triangle formed by the line 2x + 3y = 12 and the coordinate axes?
questions.solution:
x-intercept: y = 0 → x = 6. y-intercept: x = 0 → y = 4.
Area = ½ × 6 × 4 = 12 sq units.
